item.title: Slemish College pupils build global friendships with Ukrainian classmates

item.title: Mid Ulster police seize £80k in drugs during targeted action
item.description: Drugs seized by police in Mid Ulster Police in Mid Ulster have seized drugs valued at over £80,000 in a major operation targeting local drug supply. During a coordinated Day of Action on Friday 20 February, officers recovered Class A and B substances, including suspected cocaine, ketamine, and cannabis.
